column1: # routing-table.tsv - the mechanized form of the spec-9 SEMANTIC page mapping,
# pattern semantics: a lowercase COMPACTED token, alphanumerics only - the same
# compaction the advice script applies to page names (lowercase, every other
# character dropped; umlauts are STRIPPED ENTIRELY by that compaction, so the
# ae/oe/ue spelling and the stripped spelling are different tokens - add both
# spellings where they occur). A source page routes to the named target home
# when its compacted slug OR its compacted title CONTAINS the pattern; patterns
# shorter than 3 characters are ignored. The check runs AFTER the exact
# agreed-page slug/menu-label match and BEFORE artefact-anchor matching, and
# the folder-landing-page guard still applies. When several patterns hit the
# same page the LONGEST pattern wins; the earlier row wins a length tie.
# target: the agreed page (no .md) the content merges into - spec 9e branch 3.
# A human EXTENDS this table per module family (organ modules, PRO instruments,
# ... each bring their own recurring page names); rows are never removed
# silently - retire one with a note in the migration report instead.
# Initial rows: spec 9 + 9e, German aliases included.
